outer_carapace_asa_structural.structural_purpose: Woodpecker energy-diverting outer shell (Matte ASA). Sliced with 5 heavy wall loops at high heat to ensure maximum impact shatter resistance and complete UV weatherproofing. Retains absolute circular geometry to cleanly receive the internal auxetic structure.

internal_crumple_web_tpu_95a.structural_purpose: 3D Re-entrant auxetic honeycomb shock web (95A Dense TPU). Sliced with top and bottom layers dropped to 0 to keep the bow-tie honeycomb channels hollow and wide-open for sweat-vapor ventilation. Enforces a flat 0.00mm Z-hop lift and a strict 18.0mm/s speed cap around the angled re-entrant struts to eliminate retraction stringing, ensuring the material can compress and expand auxetically with zero physical obstructions.
